woe.text: Kellan, a sixteen-year-old with fae blood, was called by the Fae Lord Talion, who offered answers about his father if he would defeat the three witch sisters and end the Wicked Slumber.
With Ruby as his guide, he killed Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron, and later pleaded to his father in the cold of Hylda's frozen land until his hilts became a blade of light.
Hylda revived him after Ruby dragged him to her castle, gave up her crown and revealed that Talion was also responsible for the curse, so Kellan threw the crown at Talion's feet.

He helped Will capture Eriette, ending the curse, then declined Talion's reward and learned from his mother that his father was the planeswalker Oko, and he stepped through a portal hoping to find him.

mkm.text: Kellan had joined the Agency on Ravnica and earned high honors for helping to stop the god Anzrag, though at the party at Karlov Manor he mostly wanted to escape the crowd and found Kaya doing the same.
When Zegana was assassinated, he and Kaya helped Proft catch Etrata, and afterward he, Kaya and Agrus Kos agreed to find Teysa's murderer.
Judith misdirected him and Kaya toward Rakdos and trapped Agrus Kos in a crystal skull, and Kellan and Kaya were ambushed by robed attackers who dissolved into moss.
In the end Proft revealed Oba as the killer, and when Oba attacked, Kellan was flung from the ceiling and discovered he could fly.

otj.text: On Thunder Junction, Kellan came looking for his father, since Ezrim had told him he was on this plane, and he caught a falling worker midair on golden dust before being reassigned to Ral Zarek's security detail.
He met Oko on the road, told him he thought he was his father, and saved him from Sterling guards with golden vines, and Oko promised to teach him about his heritage.

But Oko abandoned him as he struggled to hold the train at the cliff edge, and later left him behind after Kellan retrieved Akul's medallion, admitting he had brought Kellan because he knew he would get them caught.
Freed by Ral Zarek, Kellan sided with Ral against Oko, and in the collapsing vault he took control of Akul's mind and ordered the dragon back inside.

big.text: Kellan discovers that the vault's ultimate prize, Loot, is not what he imagined.
